title: Quality Studio security hardening
summary: Decision-ready hardening plan for untrusted repository ingestion, review-agent and sensor isolation, credential handling, dependency advisories, result rendering, and downstream handover.

implementationLog.notes: QS-68 (wave 1) never merged to main; its 'S0 partial' claim was re-verified against current main and only partly held. QS-81 (wave 2, 2026-08-27) closed the registrar-privilege and command-backed-analyzer gaps in S0, added a CI dependency-advisory gate (S6), and wired secret scanning into repository onboarding while fixing two pre-existing correctness bugs in GitleaksSecurityScanner that had silently disabled real secret detection.
